name: Auto Frame Window
description: Measures the frame window of every input in a run automatically.

tps.name: TPS
tps.description: Physics tick rate used to convert level time to frames. 240 for stock GD.

checkpoint-interval.name: Checkpoint interval (frames)
checkpoint-interval.description: How often practice checkpoints are laid during the replay pass. Smaller = shorter trials but more checkpoints.

lead-frames.name: Lead frames
lead-frames.description: Minimum frames between the start checkpoint and the earliest shifted input.

lookahead-frames.name: Lookahead (frames)
lookahead-frames.description: A trial counts as survived if the player is alive this many frames past the input (and past the next input).

max-shift.name: Max shift
max-shift.description: Stop probing an input after this many frames early/late. Windows larger than this are reported as capped.

analysis-speed.name: Analysis speed
analysis-speed.description: Time multiplier while the analysis runs. Physics still tick at TPS.

remove-checkpoint-arg.name: removeCheckpoint arg
remove-checkpoint-arg.description: Value passed to PlayLayer::removeCheckpoint(bool first) to remove the NEWEST checkpoint. Flip this if the log says the wrong checkpoint was removed.

inject-offset.name: Inject offset (frames)
inject-offset.description: Added to every replayed input frame. Leave 0 unless the replay pass keeps desyncing on a run you know is deterministic; then try -1 or +1.
